Original dense closable exact compact-smooth gradient D_y and closed closure are fixed before epsilon/f. steps.title: Keep genuine source kernels, reflected potential and original resolvent
steps.text: Consume ConditionalLocalizedResolvent with exact source curvature/eta inputs. Retain its same J/R/S and true reflected density, positive partitions, original D before epsilon/f and ONE u before ALL C2 compact cutoffs. All original local/weak/volumeL2 identities remain visible.

steps.title: Reuse the exact quarter-scale Hessian lower bound
steps.text: The accepted ConditionalScoreDomain producer proves the lower Hessian bound for this explicit W_y. Extract only that pointwise fact; do not identify its auxiliary kernels with the resolvent kernels. Reflected and RGO operators/laws remain distinct.

steps.title: Apply the shared producer to the same localized weak data
steps.text: For each C2 cutoff extract actual volumeL2/support and every weak equation for v/Gchi/Fchi from the SAME u. Pass the true equality S_y=tilted(-W_y), original closable D/exact graph and actual lower curvature to the shared producer. It derives the actual weighted classes and same-D graph membership; the desired weighted conclusion is never a premise.
steps.formula: v=\chi u,\quad G_\chi=\chi G+u\nabla\chi,\quad A_\chi=\langle\nabla W_y,G_\chi\rangle-F_\chi.

steps.title: Exercise a true nonquadratic source potential and C2 cutoff
steps.text: The focused Test uses V=3x^2/8+sin(x)/8 with curvature[1/2,1], eta in(0,1], actual R/S/D/u and cutoff rho(x)*(x^2)^(5/2), certified C2 and not required to be smooth of all orders. It extracts true weighted MemLp/AE, original graph membership and the exact quarter-constant inequality.

steps.title: Keep the scalar endpoint separate from larger paper obligations
steps.text: No jointly measurable fiber choice, cutoff removal, rough Hessian/global Bochner, adjoint/core identity, epsilon-zero/kernel/range/Poincare/BL or either main/composition follows from this packet. TV proximity still cannot transfer an unbounded expected cost.
